_comment: GIST-960 (1M, 960d L2). High-dim ann-benchmarks test, distance ratios are noisier than SIFT — coarse PQ collapses recall. pq_chunks=120 (8d/chunk) is the high-dim sweet spot; pruned_degree=96 / max_degree=128 give denser graph neighbourhoods for high-dim navigation. l_build=200 needed for graph quality. num_threads=32 caps build wall-clock; build_ram_limit_gb=64 covers the 3.7 GB raw working set with no PQ sharding. search_list_size=300 widens search candidates for 960d.
